# Installing a cluster on vSphere using the Assisted Installer {#installing-vsphere-assisted-installer}

You can install OpenShift Container Platform on on-premise hardware or on-premise VMs by using the {{ ai_full }}. Installing OpenShift Container Platform by using the {{ ai_full }} supports `x86_64`, `AArch64`, `ppc64le`, and `s390x` CPU architectures.

The {{ ai_full }} is a user-friendly installation solution offered on the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console.

## Additional resources {#additional-resources_installing-vsphere-assisted-installer}
